newsitem.title: USA: Derma says creates chief executive office.
newsitem.headline: Derma says creates chief executive office.

text.p: Derma Sciences Inc said Friday it has created an office of the chief executive, which will be overseen by chairman Edward Quilty and will include John Borthwick, who will also continue as president.
The company also said it will announce new products over the next few weeks targeted at new market segments.

The company said it will become a supplier of advanced wound dressings and preparations, an area of medical supply that has grown at about 14 percent annually and is estimated to be over $650 million in sales.
